value.rationale: The singular-SRB existence theorem motivates geometric study of the map as its memory tends to zero. The new two-sided sharp-order Hausdorff estimate controls the entire forward core, not just a typical measure, and the uniform singular-value covering bound quantifies a dimension-one limiting degeneration. These are nontrivial global geometric facts linked by uniform persistence of arbitrarily high-period orbits; they are not a known-table recomputation or mere restatement of physical-measure singularity.
